content.text:
`npm run sync` failed because `PAYMENTS_API_URL` isn't set in the environment `accio` provides. `src/sync.js` then fell back to `http://127.0.0.1:9`, where nothing listens, so the request got `ECONNREFUSED`. `PAYMENTS_KEY` is set.

I changed `src/sync.js` so it exits straight away with a clear message when either variable is missing, instead of using the dead-port fallback. It also prints `err.message` rather than the whole axios error object. Running it now prints `sync failed: missing required env var(s): PAYMENTS_API_URL`.

The sync still won't succeed until you add `PAYMENTS_API_URL` to the `shared` environment in `accio`/Fidelius. I don't know the real endpoint, so I didn't set it. I haven't committed anything.
